channel.title: UC Santa Barbara incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from UC Santa Barbara's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: GlobalProtect Unavailable [resolved]
item.description: The cert has been updated and GlobalProtect is working again.

item.title: Gauchoprint: Limited Availability [investigating]
item.description: Mobility printing is working within campus networks. Access outside UCSB networks to Gauchoprint remains unavailable.

item.title: Gateway Dell Punchout [resolved]
item.description: The Vendor (Jaggaer) identified a default setting to enable the Dell Punchout.

item.title: Gateway Service Interruption [resolved]
item.description: The emergency promotion to address the underlying cause of the performance issue was completed successfully. Following the promotion, Jaggaer technical teams are continuing to closely monitor the JAGGAER Production environment to ensure the application and integrations remain stable and are operating normally.

item.title: BARC Disruptions [resolved]
item.description: System data was restored to a stable version and tests were successful. Confirming the system is functioning correctly again.

item.title: VPN Service Disruption [resolved]
item.description: We were able to roll back the active VPN appliance to a backup image, and stabilize services. Campus VPN service has been functional since approximately 10:45am.

item.title: Major Incident Tracking - GoAnywhere [resolved]
item.description: A fix the vendor mentioned worked. The issue was caused by a conflict with an OS update.

item.title: Service disruption - Everbridge [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved with *.everbridge.net and the *.everbridge.eu environment, and all backlog alerts have been successfully processed.

item.title: WebTMA 7 is down [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Chrome SSL Certificate Prompt [resolved]
item.description: Google has posted that they have resolved this incident. The issue was due to a configuration error that inadvertently requested client certificates. Their engineers have mitigated the issue by fully rolling back the affected configurations to a previous working state.

item.title: Google Gemini Service Disruption [resolved]
item.description:
Incident has been resolved. Google provided the following information: The issue with Gemini has been resolved for all the affected users as of Wednesday, 2026-06-10 10:30 US/Pacific.
From preliminary analysis, the issue was triggered by a performance issue in our backend database which impacted the retrieval of Gemini App tools catalog.
Our engineers mitigated the issue by optimizing the load distribution across our backend database fleet.
We thank you for your patience while we worked on resolving the issue.

item.title: Portable Radio System Disruptions [resolved]
item.description: The problem is resolved. A local generator test restarted a couple of critical systems
